title: Off-gateway mid-run state edit crashes the gateway (ViewEntry) instead of a class-U alert
outcome: An unmediated state write is flagged within 1 tick and the run ends anchored
acceptance: Live test: a state value edited off-gateway mid-run gives a reconcile alert naming nobody, suspends nobody, run completes with a RunAnchor
No traceback exit from ks run on a state.db value/hash mismatch
